title: Genetics of Recurrent Early Onset Major Depression
brief_summary: This study will identify specific genes that may cause a predisposition to depression in some families.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* History of recurrent major depression
* Has a parent or sibling with a history of recurrent major depression
* Depression began before the age of 31

Exclusion Criteria:

* Bipolar I (manic-depressive) disorder
* Schizophrenia
study_population: The study will include participants with a family history of depression.
